top_optimization_opportunities: 1. PROMPT CACHING: Static role definitions (1300-1936 tokens) re-billed on every step of every multi-step run. Adding cache_control to static blocks eliminates ~70% of system prompt costs after first call.
2. CONTEXT MANAGEMENT: Multi-step runs accumulate full history (up to 15 steps × 600 tokens/step = 9000 additional tokens). Rolling context with 5-turn window would cap this at ~3000 tokens.

3. MODEL ROUTING: Several deterministic tasks (field normalization, ticket formatting, data extraction) currently default to claude-sonnet-4-6 ($3/M) — routing to Haiku ($0.80/M) saves 73% on those calls.
4. SEMANTIC CACHING: CVE enrichment queries (threat_intel agent) repeat identical CVE IDs across scan uploads. A 24h TTL cache would eliminate 60-80% of enrichment API calls.
5. INPUT COMPRESSION: compress_for_triage() not applied to agent inputs — findings arrive with full description/synopsis prose that adds ~400 tokens per finding batch.
